subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should the experimental export contract remain healthy-exact-state only for this stack, with any partial or drifted export deferred to a separately designed snapshot mode?
rationale: The answer determines the durable portability, provenance, and recovery contract for a new public CLI command; source-level correctness cannot choose whether users should receive strict refusal or an explicitly marked snapshot artifact.

options.title: Keep exact-state-only export
options.body: Land only the fail-closed healthy-state export contract and defer snapshot artifacts, drift reports, and lineage expansion to a follow-up.

options.title: Add snapshot mode now
options.body: Require an explicit mode plus machine-readable drift and lineage metadata before allowing partial or drifted package export.

options.title: Pause the export slice
options.body: Hold this stacked PR until the broader Claws package and canonical-format direction is approved as one product contract.

recommendation.title: Keep exact-state-only export
recommendation.body: Land only the fail-closed healthy-state export contract and defer snapshot artifacts, drift reports, and lineage expansion to a follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment supplies the most concrete product criteria for the unresolved export contract.
